title: EntityRecord
description: The interchange object a DatasetStructureModel reader emits for one discovered entity. Readers in any language produce the same records for the same config and directory tree; tools build entity tables from them.

entityType.description: Name of the entity type, as declared in the config's entityTypes.

identity.description: The entity's own identity: the identifierRef (or every identifierRefs) field and its extracted value. Date, time and datetime values are ISO 8601 strings.

parents.description: Identity of each entity-typed ancestor, outermost first. Structural levels do not appear. Together with identity this is the full key of the entity.

locations.description: Where this entity was found. One entry per data location it appears in; an entity matched across locations has several.

rootStoragePathIdentifier.description: identifier of the root storage path the entity was found under.

fileSystemType.description: Whether the entity is a folder or a set of files.

paths.description: Paths relative to the root, '/'-separated. Exactly one folder path for a folder entity; one or more file paths for a file entity.

files.description: Files matched per named filePatterns entry: pattern name to relative file paths. Unnamed patterns are not reported here.

isComplete.description: true when every filePatterns entry with isRequired is matched.

metadata.description: All extracted metadata fields for this entity (including the identity fields), keyed by metadataDefinitions key. Date, time and datetime values are ISO 8601 strings.

issues.description: Human-readable problems a reader found for this entity (a cardinality 'one' pattern matched several files, an extraction returned null, ...).
